page_title: CAG 1-2 UDI | Cagliari v Udinese 03/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Alexis Sanchez (Udinese) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Elia Caprile has no trouble gathering it.
90+6' The game is interrupted now, Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90+5' The referee is firm and issues Florinel Coman (Cagliari) a deserved yellow card.
90+2' Alexis Sanchez (Udinese) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Alessandro Deiola plays a pass into the path of Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari), who shoots way too fast from mid-range and sends the ball miles over the bar.
85' Substitution. Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Sandi Lovric walks off.
84' The ball is cleared after Mattia Felici (Cagliari) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
82' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Iker Bravo (Udinese) offside.
81' What an opportunity! Jose Luis Palomino (Cagliari) wins the ball from the resulting set piece and unleashes a precise shot from inside the goal area which sails narrowly wide of the left post!
80' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Cagliari have a free kick.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Florinel Coman (Cagliari) replaces Zito Luvumbo.
79' Here comes a substitution. Adam Obert (Cagliari) is brought on as a substitute for Tommaso Augello.
78' Kosta Runjaic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese) replacing Rui Modesto.
78' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a change. Alexis Sanchez (Udinese) replaces Keinan Davis.
78' Substitution. Iker Bravo (Udinese) has come on for Oier Zarraga.
76' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
75' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
74' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play and Cagliari manage to earn a corner.
74' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mattia Felici (Cagliari) is coming onto the pitch as Nadir Zortea cannot continue after picking up an injury.
71' The total number of attempts is 5:10. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 2:3.
71' Oier Zarraga (Udinese) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Elia Caprile, who smothers the ball.
69' Referee Ermano Feliciani points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Udinese players.
69' Here is a change. Antoine Makoumbou is going off and Davide Nicola gives the last tactical orders to Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari).
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) will replace Razvan Marin.
69' Wait! The referee has now indicated he wants to check if the goal for Udinese can stand using VAR.
67' 1 - 2 It’s a GOAL! Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) gets on the end of the corner and bundles the ball into the net with his body.
67' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

67' Arthur Atta (Udinese) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Udinese can continue in their attacking effort.
65' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
65' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Udinese earn a corner.
63' Arthur Atta (Udinese) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
63' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
62' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but Maduka Okoye comes off his line to gather the ball.
62' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) sends the corner into the box, but Maduka Okoye intercepts it and averts the threat.

62' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) plays a long ball to Nadir Zortea, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear. Cagliari force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
60' Oier Zarraga (Udinese) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
59' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
58' The ball flies way wide of the left post as Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) produces an imprecise volley strike from long distance.
56' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) brings an opponent down and Ermano Feliciani interrupts the game. Udinese are awarded a free kick.
54' A precise short pass from Keinan Davis releases Sandi Lovric (Udinese) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot high over the bar.

53' The flag is raised by the referee's assistant. Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is repeatedly being caught offside. He's always hanging on the shoulder of the last man to try and get into a scoring position.
52' Keinan Davis (Udinese) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Sandi Lovric.

50' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.

49' Oumar Solet (Udinese) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Ermano Feliciani blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Cagliari, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
48' CHANCE! Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) fires just wide of the left post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Gabriele Zappa.
48' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) takes the corner but it's cleared.
47' A dangerous looking corner kick from Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) is cleared to safety by the defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Cagliari.
47' Razvan Marin (Cagliari) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. The referee blows his whistle, Cagliari are awarded a corner kick.
46' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jaka Bijol (Udinese) was quite harsh and Ermano Feliciani didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
45+1' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Elia Caprile intercepts the ball.
44' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
41' Keinan Davis (Udinese) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

37' Keinan Davis (Udinese) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Elia Caprile makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the right side of the target.

35' 1 - 1 Goal! A terrific long pass from Antoine Makoumbou picks out an unmarked Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:1.
34' Arthur Atta (Udinese) plays a lovely through ball to Keinan Davis, but he can't beat Elia Caprile and loses the ball.
33' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is caught offside once again.
32' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is repeatedly being caught offside.
30' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
30' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 3:1. Shots on target – 1:1.
27' 0 - 1 What a goal! Rui Modesto plays it to Oier Zarraga (Udinese), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Elia Caprile into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
26' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) is free in the box and Zito Luvumbo finds him with a pass, but his powerful shot skims just past the right post. Good chance!
23' Keinan Davis (Udinese) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
23' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
22' Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle after Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
20' The corner from Sandi Lovric (Udinese) is hurriedly cleared.

19' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Udinese have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
18' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.

17' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) sends a lovely cross into the penalty area and Keinan Davis attempts to score after getting on the end of it. Keinan Davis (Udinese) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
16' Total attempts – 1:0.
11' The resulting set piece from Cagliari is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

10' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. His dangerous effort is blocked by Maduka Okoye, who makes a glorious save! The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Cagliari will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
10' Oier Zarraga (Udinese) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
8' Keinan Davis (Udinese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Udinese.
7' A crossfield pass from Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) fails to find any of his teammates.
6' Oier Zarraga (Udinese) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Keinan Davis, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
5' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) plays a terrific long ball forward to Arthur Atta, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down. It's a throw-in for Udinese.

2' The cross into the penalty area from Rui Modesto (Udinese) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
1' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Udinese will have the kick-off.
Ermano Feliciani will officiate today.
